findings.text: The new condition only forces x64 on darwin/arm64 for VERSION < 14.17.0 or 15.0.0 <= VERSION < 16.0.0. For v14.17.0 through v14.x, such as 14.21.3, it now requests the darwin-arm64 slug. Node did not publish darwin-arm64 binaries before v16, as the patch's own comment says. On Apple Silicon, `nvm install 14.21.3` therefore downloads a nonexistent tarball and fails, where before it fell back to x64.
